name: Diesel Fuel Quality Prediction Launcher
description: Self-service launcher for training diesel fuel quality prediction models with customizable parameters

parameters.name: data_samples
parameters.description: Number of synthetic samples to generate for model training
parameters.tooltip: More samples = better model but longer training time

parameters.name: model_types
parameters.description: Select which ML algorithms to include in training
parameters.tooltip: Random Forest and XGBoost typically perform best

parameters.name: target_parameters
parameters.description: Select which fuel quality parameters to train models for
parameters.tooltip: Select key parameters relevant to your application

parameters.name: cross_validation
parameters.description: Number of cross-validation folds for model evaluation
parameters.tooltip: More folds = more robust evaluation but longer training

parameters.name: feature_selection
parameters.description: Apply automated feature selection to improve model performance

parameters.name: hyperparameter_tuning
parameters.tooltip: Advanced tuning takes longer but may improve performance

parameters.name: test_size
parameters.description: Fraction of data to reserve for final testing
parameters.tooltip: Standard practice is 20-30% for test set

parameters.name: random_seed
parameters.tooltip: Use same seed to reproduce identical results

parameters.name: performance_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum R² score required for model acceptance
parameters.tooltip: Models below this threshold will be flagged for review

parameters.name: export_format
parameters.tooltip: Choose formats compatible with your deployment environment

parameters.name: generate_report
parameters.description: Create comprehensive training and performance report
parameters.tooltip: Includes EDA, model comparison, and deployment recommendations

parameters.name: notification_email
parameters.description: Email address to notify when training completes
parameters.tooltip: Leave blank to disable email notifications

artifacts.name: trained_models
artifacts.description: Directory containing all trained models and scalers

artifacts.name: performance_metrics
artifacts.description: JSON file with detailed performance metrics

artifacts.name: visualization_plots
artifacts.description: EDA plots and model performance visualizations

preExecution.message: Minimum 1000 samples required for reliable training
Test size must be between 10% and 40%
Performance threshold must be at least 0.5

postExecution.message: Model performance file should be created

documentation.overview: This launcher enables self-service training of machine learning models for predicting diesel fuel quality parameters from refinery process inputs. Users can customize training parameters, select model types, and specify which quality parameters to predict.
quickStart: 1. Select target quality parameters you want to predict
2. Choose model types (Random Forest + XGBoost recommended)
3. Set training data size (8000 samples is a good default)

troubleshooting.solution: Increase data_samples, enable feature_selection, or try advanced hyperparameter_tuning
Reduce data_samples or disable computationally intensive model types
Lower performance_threshold or improve data quality
